SELECT * FROM t_record WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, fm.role, u.nickname FROM t_record r LEFT JOIN t_family_member fm ON r.family_id = fm.family_id AND r.user_id = fm.user_id AND fm.approved = 1 LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, fm.role, u.nickname FROM t_record r INNER JOIN t_family_member fm ON r.user_id = fm.user_id AND fm.family_id = #{family_id} AND fm.approved = 1 LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.family_id = #{family_id} OR r.family_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, fm.role, u.nickname FROM t_record r INNER JOIN t_family_member fm ON r.user_id = fm.user_id AND fm.family_id = #{family_id} AND fm.approved = 1 LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE fm.role = #{role} AND (r.family_id = #{family_id} OR r.family_id IS NULL) ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.*, fm.role, u.nickname FROM t_record r INNER JOIN t_family_member fm ON r.user_id = fm.user_id AND fm.family_id = #{family_id} AND fm.approved = 1 LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.user_id = #{member_user_id} AND (r.family_id = #{family_id} OR r.family_id IS NULL) ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_record (user_id, type, amount, category, remark, family_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{category}, #{remark}, #{familyId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
